variants.specifics: Brackenford: Three townsfolk: a pointer to the inn, a warning about the Ashwood wolves, a tip about smashing barrels.

rumour1.speaker: Townsman
rumour1.text: Ask at the Drowned Lantern. Ossian knows everybody's business.

rumour2.speaker: Townswoman
rumour2.text: Stay out of the Ashwood after dark! The wolves are worse this year than I've ever seen.

rumour3.speaker: Townsman
rumour3.text: I've heard the Urchins stuff what they steal into barrels and crates. Smash them open and see!

variants.specifics: Bormunt: Three townsfolk: Orrin brushes the player off, Mott points to the Sooty Lamp, Elsbeth's candles are being eaten.

rumour1.speaker: Orrin
rumour1.text: Not now, stranger. The bell's rung for my shift.

rumour2.speaker: Mott
rumour2.text: Want to hear the news? Go to the Sooty Lamp. Grumwald knows everything that goes on in Bormunt.

rumour3.speaker: Elsbeth
rumour3.text: Somebody's been eating my candles again! Who would do such a thing?!

variants.specifics: Oskry: Three townsfolk on the walkways: the night's news again, a grumble about building in a swamp, and Glynna, who flirts.

rumour1.speaker: Townswoman
rumour1.text: Did you hear? The dead climbed up the ladders again last night!

rumour2.speaker: Old fisherman
rumour2.text: We should have built this village on dry ground like sensible folk. Nothing good ever comes up out of a swamp.

rumour3.speaker: Glynna
rumour3.text: Well, hello there! You're the first visitor all year that isn't green and dripping! Hee, hee, hee!

variants.specifics: Castle Brask: Three townsfolk of Castle Brask: a pointer to the inn, a grumble about the new wall, the night's news again.

rumour1.speaker: Townswoman
rumour1.text: If it's news you want, go to the Iron Kettle. Soldiers can't keep their mouths shut after a cup or two.

rumour2.speaker: Old Man
rumour2.text: We never should have dug the new wall right through the old barrows. My mother said so and nobody listened

rumour3.speaker: Soldier
rumour3.text: Did you hear? The dead came over the north wall again last night!

variants.specifics: Vesk: Three villagers of Vesk: Mott mending nets, Brynna at the smokehouse, old Tib on the shore.

rumour1.speaker: Mott
rumour1.text: Sorry, I've got nets to mend. Try me later.

rumour2.speaker: Brynna
rumour2.text: That Master Odrel is a stingy old wizard! He ate up all our smoked eel last summer and never paid a copper!

rumour3.speaker: Tib
rumour3.text: Stay away from the water after dark. The dead come up out of it!

variants.specifics: Vorne: Three people of Vorne: a student points to the inn, a lecturer brushes the player off, a townsman passes on a tip about the Golems.

rumour1.speaker: Student
rumour1.text: Looking for gossip? The Singing Kettle is where the students go to complain.

rumour2.speaker: Townswoman
rumour2.text: Excuse me, I'm late for an examination!

rumour3.speaker: Townsman
rumour3.text: I hear the Golems on Gallow Ridge are terribly slow. Run, and they'll never catch you!

variants.specifics: Fort Kholm: Three folk of Fort Kholm: Hagen warns of the pass, old Mag frets over the stores, Lissa flirts.

rumour1.speaker: Hagen
rumour1.text: Stay away from the high pass after dark! The dead walk up there!

rumour2.speaker: Mag
rumour2.text: No sledges... no bread... and the dead at the gate.

rumour3.speaker: Lissa
rumour3.text: Ooh, a new face in the fort! Come warm yourself by my fire some night, when you're done with all that fighting.

variants.specifics: Fornath: Three townsfolk: Kettla brushes the player off, Harl states the trouble plainly, Bessamy says the same news again.

rumour1.speaker: Kettla
rumour1.text: Sorry, can't talk now. My crucible's about to spill.

rumour2.speaker: Harl
rumour2.text: Gorvane's Ogres have the Black Smeltery. No ore will come down the mountain until they're gone.

rumour3.speaker: Bessamy
rumour3.text: Did you hear? Ogres up at the Black Smeltery! Ogres!

variants.specifics: Wendle Cross: Three folk of Wendle Cross: Hesta points to the inn, Fenna repeats Rudd's news of Skeletons, Mungo grumbles about the stables.

rumour1.speaker: Hesta
rumour1.text: If it's news you want, go to the Crooked Kettle. Odo hears everything that comes down the four roads.

rumour2.speaker: Fenna
rumour2.text: Did you hear? Skeletons on the Grey Moor again last night! Rudd saw them himself!

rumour3.speaker: Mungo
rumour3.text: Whose bright idea was it to build the new stables on top of the old graveyard? Now the horses won't go in at all!

variants.specifics: Hestle: Three townsfolk of Hestle: Greda grumbles about the Mayor, Marl gives a tip about Ogre clubs, Hoskin warns of the north road.

rumour1.speaker: Greda
rumour1.text: Mayor Dulvane? The old windbag hasn't poked his nose out of the Town Hall since the Ogres came!

rumour2.speaker: Marl
rumour2.text: I've heard an Ogre's club will split a wooden shield clean in two. Get yourself something sturdier.

rumour3.speaker: Hoskin
rumour3.text: Beware of the north road after dark! The Ogres come down off the hill with torches.
